title: Modeling Quantum Optomechanical STIRAP
summary: Quantum optomechanical STIRAP (Stimulated Raman Adiabatic Passage) is investigated for a system of two mechanical modes coupled to an optical mode. We show analytically that in a system without loss, fractional STIRAP can generate a mechanical Bell state from a single phonon Fock state of one of the mechanical modes with the other mechanical mode in the vacuum state, and a product state from a coherent state.
